description: The adult fall armyworm is a nocturnal moth responsible for laying eggs on crop leaves. These eggs hatch into destructive larvae.
symptoms: Egg masses covered with gray scales on leaves
Presence of moths around crop fields at night
spread: Strong flying moths capable of long-distance migration
Egg laying on leaves of host plants
management: Use pheromone traps to monitor moth populations
chemical_control: Target treatments applied when larvae emerge
